svg.text: STAGE 4 / APPROVED RASTER TO SVG / V02
Original framing, poses and ground lines preserved. The vector artwork contains editable paths, not embedded images.
Measured at 1254 × 1254 with a 50% binary threshold. All binary differences stay within a 1-pixel boundary band.
White paper and light regions became transparency. Fine grey edge pixels were normalized to one ink; no anatomy was reconstructed.
